label: RULE 1
head: Don't negotiate with the calendar
sub: Gym 6AM. Lights out 9:30PM. Work flexes around them, never the reverse.

label: RULE 2
head: Sleep more than your coworkers
sub: Recovery, appetite and the 2PM crash all run on sleep.

label: RULE 3
head: Make the boring choices permanent
sub: Same breakfast. 3 lunches on rotation. Workouts planned a block ahead.

text: Rigid fitness habits *buy back your freedom* everywhere else.
